changelog: **Shared session minutes (#1847):** `SessionNote` — the pair's co-authored record of what was said and agreed — is a third model beside the two private ones; `PersonalNote` (author-only) and `RelationNote` (mentor-private) are untouched, and the e2e proves a mentor's private note stays invisible and unwritable to the mentee. `SessionNoteRevision` is an append-only trail (body as saved + editor, last 20 kept, no diff UI). `/api/session-notes` (`GET ?relationId=` / `?meetingId=`, `POST`) and `/api/session-notes/[id]` (`GET`, `PATCH`) use the relation rule from `src/lib/sessionNoteAccess.ts` (admin, mentor, mentee read; another tenant's note 404, a tenant-mate outside the pairing 403), `loadAccessibleMeeting` for a meeting-pinned note, the archived-relation 409 `inactive_relation`, and a new 403 `admin_read_only`: an admin reads, they do not author on the pair's behalf. Saving identical text writes no revision. Writes publish a `sessionNote` realtime event (no counter moves; the inbox refresher ignores it) so `SessionNotePanel` shows both seats the same text live; mounted beside the agenda on `/mentor/mentees/[id]` and `/portal/goals`. Account erasure also blanks the minutes and their revisions of the erased mentee's relations. EN/TR/DE `sessionNotes.*`. E2E `e2e/session-notes.spec.ts` (`@smoke`).

en: After a session, either of you can write the minutes — what was said and agreed — and both of you read and edit the same text. Every save keeps a version with who saved it. Your private notes stay private; this is a new, shared record beside them.
tr: Oturumdan sonra ikinizden biri tutanağı yazabilir — ne konuşuldu, nelerde anlaşıldı — ve ikiniz de aynı metni okuyup düzenlersiniz. Her kayıt, kimin kaydettiğiyle birlikte bir sürüm olarak saklanır. Özel notlarınız özel kalır; bu, onların yanında yeni ve ortak bir kayıttır.
de: Nach einer Sitzung kann jede Seite das Protokoll schreiben — was besprochen und vereinbart wurde — und beide lesen und bearbeiten denselben Text. Jedes Speichern behält eine Version mit der Person, die gespeichert hat. Eure privaten Notizen bleiben privat; das hier ist eine neue, gemeinsame Aufzeichnung daneben.
